regions.name: 구겨진 종이굴
regions.palette: warm ash-beige / weathered paper taupe, illuminated material around #a99a82, midtone #6c6150. Warm pale gray-brown, lightest of the four areas. NOT orange, yellow sand or sepia monochrome.
regions.prompt:
Recolor ONLY this existing production ground material strip for the original 2D game Unfinished Sketchbook. Preserve EXACT pixel composition, dimensions/aspect ratio, surface position at the top, all material folds, roots or wood grain, texture scales, silhouette, gradients and detail level. Do not redraw, add, remove, sharpen or move any feature. Do not add a background, scenery, labels, text, panels or empty air.
Target subarea: 구겨진 종이굴. Color direction: warm ash-beige / weathered paper taupe, illuminated material around #a99a82, midtone #6c6150. Warm pale gray-brown, lightest of the four areas. NOT orange, yellow sand or sepia monochrome..
The prior version was too monochrome to distinguish areas. Apply an unmistakable but restrained, low-to-moderate saturation natural tint to the near-surface and mid-depth material. Make the hue legible at ordinary game viewing size, not just a barely visible color cast. Retain subtle material variation instead of one flat uniform color wash. Preserve the dark-metroidvania mood and readable contact edge, with no baked spotlight. Keep original luminance structure, allowing up to 10 percent lift only in readable upper midtones to reveal the color. Fade this tint away smoothly as depth increases; bottom 20 percent remains almost neutral black #050608, not colored fog. The image must remain a full solid rectangular material cross-section with a thin surface at the TOP border and progressive darkening toward its bottom. This is color grading of an existing reusable texture, not a new concept or layout.
